title: 70 ### X. POLICE PERSONNEL KILLED OR INJURED During 1971, 187 police personnel were killed as against 148 during 1970, out of which 39.5% were in West Bengal alone. Accidents and Criminals were responsible for 33.1% of such deaths. Riotous mobs killed 45 police personnel.
